h1: Swift packages and SDKs you can reuse
overview: If your apps repeat the same code, we turn it into a clean Swift package that you add through Swift Package Manager. We design a small, clear public interface, write unit tests and a README with examples, and set up versioning so updates are safe. You can keep the package private for your team or publish it yourself. We build it to your needs.

faq: You do. It is delivered to your repository with a licence of your choice, or kept private. We keep no rights to it and do not reuse your code for other clients.
Can you extract a package from my existing app?
Yes. We pull shared logic out of your current project, give it a clean interface and update your app to use it. Updating several apps to use the package is quoted separately.
Can the package support CocoaPods or Carthage too?
Swift Package Manager is our default. We can add a CocoaPods spec if you need it, though Apple tooling has moved toward Swift Package Manager. Tell us which one your team uses.
Do you write the unit tests?
Yes, every package includes tests for the main behavior. Premium adds continuous integration, so the tests run on every change in your repository, for example with GitHub Actions.
